make_or_buy_basis: Repeatable seat modules use the common service rail and calculated saddle adapters instead of unique brackets through floor panels.

material_spec.finish_or_protection: cleanable graffiti-resistant finish, radiused passenger edges, isolated dissimilar metals and accessible captive service fasteners
material_spec.form_factor: replaceable seat modules mounted only through LM3-FIX saddles to structural/common rails, never through finish panels
material_spec.governing_standard: supplier rail-seat specification plus project fire/smoke, occupant/abuse load, sharp-edge, accessibility, corrosion and cleanability evidence
material_spec.grade_or_part_class: fire-rated longitudinal seat shells/cushions, metallic frame, common-rail saddles, anti-rotation keys, isolators and captive locking hardware
material_spec.material_family: rail passenger-seat module and calculated mounting kit
material_spec.nominal_section: seat pitch, cant, aisle/PRM clearance, hand clearance, saddle engagement and fastener grip fixed by LM3-INT-230 drawings and released load calculation
material_spec.traceability: seat serial/batch, fire certificate, adapter variant, fastener lot, torque/locking witness and installed position map

joining_methods: sealed, gasketed, bonded, or clipped interface as supplier envelope requires
process_spec.release_level: SOURCE supplier-controlled process; OSR controls envelope and acceptance evidence

fit_gaps: Exact seat model, upholstery, spacing, handrail geometry and calculated attachment loads remain open.
supplier_anchor.localisation: The OSR common rail and adapters are local; seat shells, frames and handrails may be locally made after fire, abuse-load, sharp-edge, corrosion and accessibility validation.
mandatory_equivalence: same or better released fit, mounting datums, connector keying and service envelope
same or better mass, load, duty-cycle, thermal, electrical and environmental ratings
same or better functional safety, fire, EMC, cybersecurity and applicable rail evidence
documented failure modes, maintenance intervals, spares and obsolescence route
first-article inspection plus component, subassembly and vehicle regression tests
signed design-authority substitution record preserving the original anchor and evidence hashes
supplier_anchor.product_family: Metro and urban rail passenger seating
supplier_anchor.release_boundary: A web page is not a purchase specification. Design authority must freeze the exact supplier part number, configuration, drawings, software, evidence, commercial terms and spares through RFQ before release. Safety-critical substitutes require calculation, test, independent assessment and authority acceptance.
